Indian Rupee Strengthens Against US Dollar

The Indian Rupee saw an increase in value against the US dollar in early trade on Monday. Reports indicate the rupee rose by 24 paise to 95.72, 15 paise to 95.81, and 5 paise to 95.82 against the dollar, with different outlets reporting slightly varied figures. The strengthening is attributed to falling crude oil prices and gains in equity markets. The dollar index, measuring the dollar's strength against other currencies, was trading higher. Traders are monitoring oil prices and foreign portfolio flows for further cues, with expectations that the Reserve Bank of India may intervene to manage sharp currency fluctuations.
